stories.summary: The authority says the sale could reduce competition for mast access in rural areas. Tessaly says it will offer remedies.

stories.headline: Lenmark Retail secures a covenant waiver from its banks
stories.summary: The waiver runs to the end of the financial year. Lenmark pays a small fee for it.

stories.summary: The filing lists two new related-party loans.

issues.summary: Covers 9 to 13 Nov 2026. Written by a model from 41 stories in Leveraged credit, Shipping and Packaging.

points.lead: Packaging issuers are cutting capacity, not prices
points.body: Three issuers announced plant closures this week. Each kept guidance and booked a one-off charge, which puts the cost in the same quarter as their covenant step-downs.

points.lead: Two telecoms disposals are now in in-depth review
points.body: Both sellers planned to repay 2027 debt from the proceeds. A review of this kind usually adds months, so the repayment dates are less certain than a week ago.
